events.title: NEW: ADNOC Tankers Attacked by UAVs in Strait of Hormuz (Aug 13)
events.summary: Two ADNOC vessels attacked by Iranian UAVs while transiting Strait of Hormuz on Aug 13. UAE condemned as piracy. UKMTO confirmed UAV strikes. No injuries. Direct escalation of Iran-Hormuz crisis. Hormuz traffic remains low, world burning through oil stockpiles.

events.title: NEW: ECB Confirmed to Hike Rates 25bps to 2.50% in September
events.summary: Reuters poll (Aug 10-13): 83% of economists expect ECB hike to 2.50% in Sept. Shortest tightening cycle since 2011. France fiscal crisis context. Morningstar sees possible further hikes.

events.title: NEW: Private Credit Distress Escalating - Investors Pulling Billions
events.summary: ZeroHedge: investors pulling billions from private credit funds. Public markets calm but private credit PIK distress growing. Hedge fund Treasury leverage at 100x. Fitch defaults rising. Russia bankruptcies +13.7% YoY.

events.title: ESCALATION: BOJ Rate Hike Odds Jump to 75% - Government Supports Sept/Oct Move
events.summary: Bloomberg Aug 13: PM Takaichi government supports near-term BOJ rate hike. Market odds 60% to 75%. Joint FX intervention failing, yen at ~159. 10Y JGB 2.87%, 30Y 4.00%. Japan debt 194% GDP.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis CONTINUES - Traffic Low, Stockpiles Depleting
events.summary: Hormuz closed since Jul 12. ADNOC attacks Aug 13. Trump claims control, Iran refutes. OPEC+ +206kbpd. EIA: prices elevated until flows normalize. 20M bpd disrupted.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - Fastest Growing Ever, Now in DRC and Uganda
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus in DRC and Uganda. WHO PHEIC declared May 17. Fastest-growing on record. Existing treatments for Zaire strain, not Bundibugyo. No containment.

events.title: France Debt Snowball - Fiscal Mess Out of Control
events.summary: France debt EUR3.5T+. H1 2026 interest +19% YoY. Deficit 5.13%. Debt-to-GDP 118%. Reuters: fiscal mess out of control. Funding above all eurozone peers.

events.title: UK Food Security Red Alert - 27M Hosepipe Bans, Worst Drought in Decades
